Please check Warranty Policy for more information. EDM FAQs Q1: Why does my 2TB G55H only show about 1.86TB in Windows or BIOS? Answer: Totally normal! The box uses 2TB = 2,000,000,000,000 bytes, but computers count with 1024, so it always shows 7~10% less. We reserve a tiny bit for the drive's health too. Every SSD does this  all your space is still usable for games or files! Q2: What's the max speed, and why might I not hit 10,300 MB/s read / 9,000 MB/s write? Answer: Up to 10,300 MB/s read and 9,000 MB/s write. But you need a PCIe Gen5 motherboard slot, like on new Intel/AMD boards. Older Gen4 slots cap at about 7,000 MB/s, and Gen3 at about 3,500 MB/s. Check your motherboard specs for full rocket speed! Q3: Will the G55H work in my PS5? Does the heatsink fit? Answer: Yes! It's 100% PS5 compatible  just pop it into the M.2 slot which meets Sony's speed and size rules. The included aluminum heatsink is only 8.75mm tall fits under the PS5 cover, which allows up to 11.25mm. No extra thermal pads needed; it'll handle 4K gaming like a champ. Q4: Is the G55H backward compatible with older PCs or laptops? Answer: Absolutely! It works in any PCIe 3.0 or 4.0 M.2 slot like on most laptops or older desktops. You'll get solid speeds just not the full Gen5 blast. Perfect upgrade for Intel/AMD systems no compatibility headaches. Q5: Does the G55H get hot? Is the heatsink good enough for gaming? Q5: Does the G55H get hot? Is the heatsink good enough for gaming? Answer: It can get warm during heavy loads like ray traced games, but the premium aluminum heatsink with grid design keeps temps low and steady. No throttling issues in tests it's built for long sessions on PS5 or PC. Safer than bare drives! bottom of page
